scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @portfolio/web" "npm run dev -w @portfolio/api"
scripts.build: npm run generate -w @portfolio/api && npm run build -w @portfolio/web && npm run build -w @portfolio/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/web && npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/api
